name: Water access and use
what: Hold a water access licence or entitlement to take water for irrigation, stock or processing, and meet Murray-Darling Basin rules where they apply.

basis.source: Agriculture, forestry and fishing industry (industry information)
basis.quote: use water for irrigation, stock watering or aquaculture

basis.source: Agriculture, forestry and fishing industry (industry information)
basis.quote: The Water Act 2007 may apply if your business uses or trades water in the Murray-Darling Basin.

issues.what: Irrigators and water operators report the same data to state and Commonwealth agencies in different formats.

evidence.quote: overlapping Australian and state government responsibilities in the management of water resources. Farmers said that they are required to submit the same or similar data to different agencies.
In some cases, different types of data must be provided in different formats to the same agency. In other cases, the same data must be provided to different agencies.
